main.description: List the posts of a space-backed private feed. The feed is named by its ordinary public app.bsky.feed.generator URI; the records it returns live in a permissioned space and their URIs are not at-uris, which is why this is not app.bsky.feed.getFeed. Requires a signed-in viewer the space authorises to view.

feed.description: The public feed-generator record. Its paired community.blacksky.feed.config must name a space.

errors.name: MembershipRequired
errors.description: The viewer is not authorised to view this space. Always returned as an error, never disguised as an empty successful result.

errors.name: NotSpaceBacked
errors.description: The feed exists but is not backed by a permissioned space. Read it through app.bsky.feed.getFeed instead.
